What happens to my storage on Premium expiry?
On day 0 you pick one box to keep. Day 17: non-kept boxes are deleted and your kept box is trimmed to 100 items. Renew before then to keep everything.
Can I store videos in Media Storage?
Yes. Videos are kept within the per-item size limits (up to 25MB for free / up to 50MB for Premium) and stored separately from photos, without quality loss.
